published.source: DPS report 2026-10-28 (full re-sim at 20,000 iterations, 180 s, after the launch-realm hunter hotfix)

summary: Keeps its own Curse of the Elements up for the raid, with the raid's copy off. Under Forever the curse has its own slot, so the bane stays.
rotation: Pre-pull: Shadow Bolt at -2.5s (lands just after the pull)
Racials on cooldown, except Troll Berserking
Life Tap below 5% mana or when the filler costs more than the mana left
Curse of the Elements on duty for the raid, right after the opener and recast before it drops
Bane of Doom when it lands before the fight ends (more than 60s left)
Bane of Agony while Bane of Doom is on cooldown or would not land
Corruption when it is down (more than 9s left)
Immolate when down or when less than its cast time remains (more than 15s left)
Death Coil, then Searing Pain, when the filler would not land before the fight ends
Troll Berserking just before a Shadow Bolt with the GCD free, so its cast speed goes on casts, not the instant opener
Shadow Bolt as the filler (instant on Nightfall procs)
caveats: A bane and a curse use separate slots, so the duty curse costs only GCDs and mana.
The Wrack and Siphon Life DoT variant is 55 behind. Drain fillers are 124 to 349 behind.
Demon shares and Succubus melee are wowsims/forever's, read on pet sheets at levels 20 and 30, not 60.
Bane of Doom's coefficient is 4.0 (Era 1.0). At 2.0 Shadow Bolt builds lose about 4%, at 1.0 about 6%.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Shadow Bolt IX, Immolate VII, Corruption VI): 7 to 13 DPS.
Only the Demonheart Raiment 2-piece is live (the 5-piece added about +8 to +13 on the first set)
Soul shards and Life Tap's health cost aren't tracked.
Demons use the warlock's spell crit (forever-bugs #331). Worth 15 to 17 DPS.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as warlock__affliction except -apl level60_affliction_duty_curse, then raid.debuffs.curseOfElements set to false. Demon Armor; Summon Succubus, sacrificed NoSummon, imbue Spellstone. mksettings sets distanceFromTarget 5 / channelClipDelayMs 50 where the UI preset uses 25 / 150; the published numbers were made with mksettings and reproduce exactly.
